shell-view.description: Toolbar, mini-month, view switcher, time-zone label, and narrow-viewport fallback composing every calendar view.

examples.note: Switch views, move the focused date, toggle weekends, and change the time zone. Proposals land in the log below.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone calendar shell component.

props.note: The shell owns view and focusedDate signals and forwards events, tasks, and holidays to the active view.

responsive.note: At 640px or narrower the shell projects the schedule agenda by default. Resize the viewport or set responsiveFallback to null to disable.

shell-view.title: Calendar Shell
